n: Can I Transfer My GTA Online Character to GTA 6?
d: GTA Online character transfer to GTA 6 has not been confirmed. Rockstar has not addressed progress or character transfer. A fresh start is considered likely.
GTA 6 has real-time ray tracing, shown in Digital Foundry's analysis of Trailer 2. Hardware-accelerated on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
Rockstar has not named a GTA 6 antagonist. What two trailers and the official bios actually show about the threats circling Jason and Lucia, theory by theory.
No GTA 6 cheats confirmed yet. Every previous GTA game has had cheat codes. GTA 6 cheat codes will be confirmed at or after launch.

n: How Big Is the GTA 6 Download?
d: GTA 6 download size not confirmed. Based on GTA 5 at 90GB and the scale of GTA 6, estimates range from 100GB to 150GB. Official size unannounced.

n: Is There Early Access for GTA 6?
d: No GTA 6 early access or pre-load date confirmed. Rockstar has not announced early access. Pre-load dates typically go live 3-7 days before launch.

n: How Big Is the GTA 6 Map?
d: GTA 6 map size not officially confirmed. Community analysis and leaker estimates suggest it is larger than GTA 5 but comparable to RDR2. Full breakdown.

n: Does GTA 6 Have a Physical Collector's Edition?
d: No physical collector's edition was announced. GTA 6 has Standard ($79.99, physical and digital) and Ultimate ($99.99, digital only). Physical copies ship with a download code, no disc.
Yes. GTA 6 pre-orders opened June 25, 2026. Standard Edition $79.99, Ultimate Edition $99.99. Pre-order bonus: the Vintage Vice City Pack.

n: What's in the GTA 6 Pre-Order Bonus?
d: The GTA 6 pre-order bonus is the Vintage Vice City Pack, '55 Vapid Stanier, Jason and Lucia outfits, tropical weapon pattern. Digital pre-orders also get one free month of GTA+.

n: When Do GTA 6 Pre-Orders Get Charged?
d: PlayStation charges immediately. Xbox charges up to 10 days before November 19. Amazon charges at shipment. Most physical retailers charge at order. Full platform breakdown.

n: GTA 6: PS5 vs Xbox Series X
d: No official performance differences confirmed between GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Digital Foundry analysis of trailers shows comparable rendering.

n: Does GTA 6 Have a Manual Save System?
d: GTA 6 save system not confirmed. Based on GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2, expect a mix of autosave checkpoints and a manual save option. No official details yet.

n: Who Are the GTA 6 Voice Actors?
d: Rockstar has not announced a GTA 6 cast. Manni L. Perez and Dylan Rourke are the names the community points to for Lucia and Jason. Current status of every name.

n: How Does the GTA 6 Wanted System Work?
d: GTA 6 has seven law enforcement agencies across Leonida with distinct jurisdictions: VCPD, VCSO, LSP, NOOSE, and more.

n: How Many Protagonists Does GTA 6 Have?
d: GTA 6 has two protagonists, not three. Why Rockstar dropped GTA 5's three-way split for Jason and Lucia, and what that means for how the story plays.
GTA 6 Standard Edition costs $79.99. Ultimate Edition costs $99.99 (digital only). No physical collector's edition. Announced by Rockstar, June 2026.
No PC release date confirmed for GTA 6. Based on previous GTA history, a PC port is expected 12-18 months after the November 2026 console launch.
GTA 6 cross-platform multiplayer has not been confirmed. GTA Online has never been cross-platform. The pattern suggests GTA 6 Online will follow the same model.
GTA 6 will not be on Game Pass at launch, per Strauss Zelnick. A title of this scale on day-one subscription is inconsistent with Take-Two's model.
No official source says Lucia is pregnant or has a child. Where the theory started, what the 2023 leak claimed, and what Rockstar's own bios actually say.

n: Is the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Worth It?
d: The GTA 6 Ultimate Edition is $20 more than Standard. The key difference: five exclusive shops, five extra vehicles, custom weapons, and exclusive clothing and tattoos. Digital only.

n: What Is the GTA 6 Age Rating?
d: GTA 6 is not yet officially ESRB rated. Australia rated it MA15+. Every mainline GTA has received M (17+) from ESRB and PEGI 18 in Europe.
GTA 6 releases November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Set by Rockstar Newswire on November 6, 2025. No PC date announced.

n: Who Are the Main Characters in GTA 6?
d: GTA 6 has two protagonists: Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval. Full character profiles, connections, and supporting cast in the database.
